name: Facebook Clean View
description: Removes login walls and clutter from Facebook for TV browsing

params.css: [data-testid='cookie-policy-manage-dialog'], [role='dialog'][aria-label*='log in'], ._5hn6, [class*='login'], #login_popup_cta_form, [data-testid='royal_login_form'] { display: none !important; } body, html { overflow: auto !important; position: static !important; filter: none !important; } .userContentWrapper, [role='article'] { font-size: 18px !important; line-height: 1.7 !important; } img { border-radius: 8px !important; }

params.code: document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"]').forEach(function(d) { if (d.textContent.includes('Log') || d.textContent.includes('Sign') || d.textContent.includes('Create')) d.remove(); }); document.body.style.overflow = 'auto'; document.body.style.position = 'static'; return 'done';
